I saved this as a project convention in EngramDB, so it will come up in future sessions: all background jobs go through `jobs.enqueue()`, never through Celery directly (`.delay()`, `.apply_async()`, `send_task()`, etc.). I'll also treat direct Celery calls as violations when I review code.

Right now the repo has no `jobs.enqueue` and no Celery calls at all, so there's nothing to migrate yet. I noted that in the memory too.
